## About
Diamond Automotive is a collision repair shop on SW 58th Ave in West Park, led by John Rodriguez, President, and Justin Rodriguez, VP of Operation. Our repair process managers, parts, accounting and claims staff all work under one roof.
We understand that an accident can be a very emotional and stressful situation. That is why we put so much weight on personal care for every customer. We work with all major insurance carriers and help with the paperwork and your rental car.
We are rated 4.9 from 1406 Google reviews, and our customers often thank the person who handled their repair by name.

## Services
- Auto body repair: Body and collision work, with the vehicle checked and cleaned before it goes home.
- Auto insurance claims: We guide you through each step of the claim and make sure the required procedures are completed correctly.
- Diagnosis and estimate: One reviewer said Manny was extremely helpful through the diagnosis and estimate.
- Auto glass repair: Glass repair handled as part of getting your vehicle back in shape.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: We work with all major insurance carriers and guide you through each step of the claim.

Q: Can you help with a rental car?
A: Yes. Managing your rental car and the paperwork is part of how we help with your claim.

Q: How will I know where my repair stands?
A: We update you as your vehicle moves through the repair stages, by text, phone or email.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday mornings from 8:00 to 11:30 AM. We are closed on Sunday.
